queries.claim: One row per mapped plate appearance with explicit event and duration components.
A transparent exploratory PA score computed from mapped pitch, swing, contact, and foul counts.
Observed pitch, swing, contact, terminal-contact, hit, and out conversion by batter.
Mapped swings without contact and pitches without swings, bounded by direct-mapping coverage.
Explicit event and PA-result evidence for each observed batter-pitcher pairing.
Non-hit PAs associated with an explicit safe advance or run by another runner; not official RBI attribution.
Mapped terminal contact chains grouped by their explicit institutional result.
Explicit batting and runner-event composition within each mapped half inning.
Mapped domain-event counts normalized by the recorded game temporal interval.
Explicit official-scorer judgment types and judged processes.
Final post-review umpire call judgments with mapped swing/contact context and explicit replay disposition when supplied by MLB.
Explicit replay type and disposition alongside MLB's final structured play and pitch outcomes; original calls are not reconstructed.
Players observed with all four explicit hit-result classes in the selected corpus.
Safe and run destinations evidenced by BaseTouchingProcess participants and successors.
Mapped StealAttemptAct outcomes with unresolved attempts exposed rather than treated as failures.
Contact games lacking reviewed positive contact contribution evidence, within the mapped result vocabulary.
Structural defects and generic-only terminal outcome gaps in mapped event-to-result-to-adjudication chains; every returned row is a finding.

blockedAnalytics.reason: No reviewed score-state and expectancy model is represented in the RDF.
Coordinate sites exist, but numeric coordinate values are not mapped.
RBI, earned-run, and left-on-base continuity are not fully represented.
The current counted-foul mapping is not a complete pitch-by-pitch count-state model.
